title: Les petits pédestres
description: Explore, fight, survive, and craft with this modpack.
body:
# LPPD

## A Vanilla+ Immersion & Adventure Modpack

LPPD is a carefully curated Minecraft 1.21.1 modpack focused on **immersion, exploration, atmosphere, and enhanced gameplay** while staying true to the spirit of vanilla Minecraft.

Rather than completely overhauling the game, the pack expands existing systems with richer environments, improved combat, more detailed world generation, enhanced villages, seasonal changes, and dozens of quality-of-life improvements.

---

## ✨ Visual & Atmospheric Enhancements

The pack includes optional shaders and resource packs alongside numerous visual improvements to make the world feel more alive:

- Optional shader support with **Complementary Reimagined** and **MakeUp Ultra Fast**
- Dynamic weather and seasonal changes
- Enhanced ambient sounds and sound physics
- Improved entity models and textures
- Falling leaves, realistic rain, drip sounds, and environmental effects
- Distant Horizons support for massive view distances
- Better third-person camera and visual feedback systems

The goal is to create a world that feels believable and immersive without sacrificing performance.

---

## ⚔️ Expanded Combat & Adventure

Combat is enhanced through a collection of medieval-inspired mods that add new equipment, enemies, and mechanics:

- Epic Knights armor and weapons
- Better Combat animations and combat flow
- Immersive Armors
- Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
- New hostile creatures and invasion events
- Improved boss encounters
- Revive mechanics for multiplayer worlds

Players can choose between becoming a heavily armored knight, a wandering adventurer, a spellcaster, or something in between.

---

## 🏘️ Living World

Villages and exploration have been expanded to make the world feel more populated and dynamic:

- Guard Villagers
- Friends & Foes
- Take a Pillage
- Illager Invasion
- Better Archaeology
- Map Atlases
- New structures, creatures, and points of interest

NPCs, villages, and exploration opportunities are significantly more engaging than in vanilla Minecraft.

---

## 🌿 Farming, Food & Immersion

LPPD adds depth to survival without turning it into a hardcore experience:

- Farmer's Delight
- Vinery
- Brewery
- Bakery
- Farm & Charm
- Herbal Brews
- Meadow
- Wilder Nature
- Aquaculture

Players can build farms, taverns, vineyards, fishing settlements, or thriving medieval towns.

---

## ⚙️ Engineering & Creativity

While much of the pack leans toward immersion and medieval aesthetics, technology still has a place.

The inclusion of **Create** allows players to build mechanical contraptions, automated farms, transportation systems, and industrial-style infrastructure without disrupting the overall Vanilla+ feel.

---

## 🎯 Design Philosophy

LPPD is built around a simple goal:

> **Make Minecraft feel richer, more immersive, and more alive without making it frustrating or unrecognizable.**

The pack avoids excessive grind, unnecessary complexity, and dramatic progression changes. Instead, it focuses on expanding what already makes Minecraft enjoyable through better visuals, deeper exploration, improved combat, and a more believable world.

Whether you're building a medieval settlement, exploring distant lands, automating with Create, or simply enjoying a more atmospheric survival experience, LPPD aims to provide a polished and immersive Vanilla+ adventure.


---

## ⚙️ Installation

- For **dedicated server** use: Install the server version of the modpack.
- For **singleplayer** use: Install the singleplayer version of the modpack.
- For **multiplayer** use: Install the client version of the modpack.
